1.consolidated_definition: Es la llamada horquilla que se compone de un anillo de alambre que se le coloca al cerdo en el hocico para que al hozar le duela y no lo haga.
1.en_consolidated_definition: It is the called "horquilla" that consists of a wire ring placed on the pig's snout to make it painful when it roots and thus prevent it from doing so.
